title: Code for "Representation can dissociate from function and behaviour in task-optimised vision networks"
description:
Code and figures accompanying the extended abstract "Representation can dissociate from function and behaviour in task-optimised vision networks", presented at the 9th Annual Conference on Cognitive Computational Neuroscience (CCN 2026) in New York, USA.

The training runs behind Figure 1 are archived separately at doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24162774.
